professional_summary: UX/UI Designer with expertise in user research, interaction design, and digital product delivery. Experienced across B2B SaaS, enterprise tools, fintech, healthcare, and public sector projects. Strong background in translating complex requirements into user-centered designs, with proficiency in Figma, user research methodologies, and accessibility standards. Previous career as a Senior Associate in corporate law brings transferable skills in stakeholder management, contract negotiation, and synthesizing complex information. Currently working as a contract UX Designer following career transition and completion of UX Design Immersive training.
